column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 08 (M23008) & 09 (M23009): Igla diidentifikasi, Voymastina tiba.
# Tetap Inggris: Igla, Lentine, Omen Squad, Nikketa, Klukai, Mechty, Belka, Andoris,
# Cheyanne, Voymastina, Vasily, Mokosh, Mangi Security, Squad 404, Monsoon Squad,
# Oathguards, Boojum, Frame, Neural cloud, Doll.
# Catatan: baris dengan {} adalah placeholder game — jangan diubah.

(Inside the command center, the news that the enemy's target was me made Vasily subconsciously tense up, and the squad members who had stayed behind to guard us also raised their guard to the highest level.)
column2: (Di dalam pusat komando, kabar bahwa sasaran musuh adalah aku membuat Vasily tanpa sadar menegang, dan anggota regu yang tinggal menjaga kami pun menaikkan kewaspadaan ke tingkat tertinggi.)

column1: Targeting me and deploying Igla to complete the mission, all of this is within expectations.
column2: Mengincarku dan mengerahkan Igla untuk menuntaskan misinya, semua ini masih dalam perkiraan.

column1: Commander, who is this Doll named Igla?
column2: Komandan, siapa Doll bernama Igla ini?

column1: Igla... is a third-generation Doll belonging to the Financial Conglomerate. Her two masters both have some history with me.
column2: Igla... adalah Doll generasi ketiga milik Financial Conglomerate. Kedua tuannya sama-sama punya sejarah denganku.

column1: Mokosh's resistance probably exceeded their expectations. Igla wanting to find my whereabouts is highly likely because she wants to find a breakthrough from me.
column2: Perlawanan Mokosh mungkin melampaui perkiraan mereka. Igla mencari keberadaanku kemungkinan besar karena ingin mencari celah terobosan lewat aku.

column1: The third-generation Dolls have already been sent to the front line, proving that the Commander behind them had made up their mind for a quick battle from the very beginning.
column2: Doll generasi ketiga sudah dikirim ke garis depan, membuktikan Komandan di belakang mereka sejak awal sudah bertekad menuntaskan pertempuran secepat mungkin.

column1: Commander, this is advantageous to us, and also aligns with the war of attrition strategy you initially proposed. As long as Mokosh can withstand the attrition, there is a chance to win.
column2: Komandan, ini menguntungkan kita, sekaligus sejalan dengan strategi perang gesekan yang Anda usulkan di awal. Selama Mokosh sanggup menahan gesekan itu, ada peluang menang.

column1: Yes, Mokosh is a good target, and also the "tool" they need to establish their authority now.
column2: Ya, Mokosh adalah sasaran yang bagus, sekaligus "alat" yang mereka butuhkan sekarang untuk menegakkan wibawa.

column1: However, Mokosh's logistics is a problem... If it's just a simple war of attrition, we still can't lock in victory.
column2: Tapi logistik Mokosh jadi masalah... Kalau cuma perang gesekan biasa, kita tetap tidak bisa mengunci kemenangan.

column1: Once the enemy makes up their mind to besiege Mokosh for a long time and our logistics are cut off, it will still cause the situation to tilt in a direction unfavorable to us.
column2: Begitu musuh bertekad mengepung Mokosh dalam waktu lama dan logistik kita terputus, keadaan tetap akan condong ke arah yang merugikan kita.

column1: Now, we must first stop Igla from continuing to destroy the front line.
column2: Sekarang, kita harus lebih dulu menghentikan Igla merusak garis depan.

column1: (And I know that the powerful support that can definitely stop Igla is right at—)
column2: (Dan aku tahu bantuan kuat yang pasti bisa menghentikan Igla ada tepat di—)

column1: (In the intelligence Nikketa sent back before the battle, it was specifically mentioned that Mangi Security had already established an exclusive Doll unit with 'Igla' as the core. And her new master now is exactly the commander of the 'Omen Squad' who has fought with me many times—Lentine.)
column2: (Dalam informasi yang dikirim Nikketa sebelum pertempuran, disebutkan secara khusus bahwa Mangi Security sudah membentuk unit Doll eksklusif dengan 'Igla' sebagai intinya. Dan tuan barunya sekarang persis komandan 'Omen Squad' yang sudah berkali-kali bertempur denganku—Lentine.)

column1: (Although I only received this intelligence after arriving in Mokosh, there was still enough leeway for me to formulate targeted tactics.)
column2: (Meski informasi ini baru kuterima setelah tiba di Mokosh, waktunya masih cukup untukku menyusun taktik yang tepat sasaran.)

column1: (The squad maneuvering with Igla as the combat core showed an unstoppable momentum on the battlefield.)
column2: (Regu yang bermanuver dengan Igla sebagai inti tempur menunjukkan momentum yang tak terbendung di medan perang.)

column1: (Under Mangi Security's fire support, a large number of defensive measures originally deployed on the outskirts of Mokosh were destroyed one after another. It wasn't until Squad 404 and Cheyanne successfully slowed down Igla's movement trajectory through cooperation that the enemy's progress in tearing apart Mokosh's defense net was delayed.)
column2: (Di bawah dukungan tembakan Mangi Security, banyak sarana pertahanan yang semula dipasang di pinggiran Mokosh hancur satu per satu. Baru setelah Squad 404 dan Cheyanne berhasil memperlambat lintasan gerak Igla lewat kerja sama, laju musuh merobek jaring pertahanan Mokosh pun tertahan.)

column1: (Sensing that Igla's actions were delayed by Squad 404, multiple drones supported Igla's further attacks from the outside in a long-range manner, and Cheyanne, who was inside the defense facility, immediately tried to shoot down the enemy.)
column2: (Merasakan gerak Igla tertahan Squad 404, beberapa drone mendukung serangan lanjutan Igla dari luar secara jarak jauh, dan Cheyanne yang berada di dalam fasilitas pertahanan langsung berusaha menjatuhkan musuh.)

column1: (The good combat performance possessed by the third-generation Doll allowed Igla to dodge almost all long-distance combat attacks, and facing long-range attacks attacking her rear, Igla could also shoot them down immediately.)
column2: (Performa tempur unggul yang dimiliki Doll generasi ketiga membuat Igla bisa mengelak hampir semua serangan jarak jauh, dan menghadapi serangan jarak jauh yang menyasar punggungnya, Igla pun bisa langsung menembak jatuh.)

column1: (The anxious war situation lasted for a long time. Even with Squad 404's pinning down, which prevented Igla from launching destructive attacks on Mokosh anymore, at the same time, other areas falling one after another were gradually pushing the situation towards a disadvantageous one for Mokosh.)
column2: (Situasi perang yang mencekam itu berlangsung lama. Meski Squad 404 menahannya sehingga Igla tak lagi bisa melancarkan serangan perusak ke Mokosh, di saat bersamaan kawasan lain yang jatuh satu demi satu perlahan mendorong keadaan ke arah yang merugikan Mokosh.)

column1: Three close-in fortifications on the West Line have been destroyed, and our fire net coverage is about to have loopholes.
column2: Tiga benteng jarak dekat di Garis Barat sudah hancur, dan jangkauan jaring tembak kita sebentar lagi berlubang.

column1: What about the mobile forces, let them go support.
column2: Bagaimana pasukan bergeraknya, suruh mereka membantu.

column1: Mobile support has all been dispatched, the number is not enough, there is still a gap. We have no more squads that can support!
column2: Semua bantuan bergerak sudah dikerahkan, jumlahnya tidak cukup, masih ada celah. Kita tidak punya regu lagi yang bisa membantu!

column1: If this continues, it is estimated that within thirty minutes, defensive loopholes may appear on the outskirts of Mokosh.
column2: Kalau begini terus, diperkirakan dalam tiga puluh menit akan muncul lubang pertahanan di pinggiran Mokosh.

column1: Monsoon Squad, prioritize supporting areas with defense gaps.
column2: Monsoon Squad, prioritaskan membantu area yang pertahanannya berlubang.

column1: Cheyanne, concentrate firepower to cover 404.
column2: Cheyanne, pusatkan daya tembak untuk melindungi 404.

column1: Klukai, three minutes.
column2: Klukai, tiga menit.

column1: Understood. Andoris, Belka, you guys go first!
column2: Dimengerti. Andoris, Belka, kalian duluan!

column1: Big Sis, you be careful too!
column2: Kak, kau juga hati-hati!

column1: (Klukai's offensive grew increasingly fierce, her iron stream of bullets constantly harassing and delaying Igla's pace. Meanwhile, Cheyanne's precise sniping always thwarted Igla's counterattacks against Klukai at crucial moments.)
column2: (Serangan Klukai makin garang, aliran peluru besinya terus mengganggu dan menahan langkah Igla. Sementara itu, tembakan jitu Cheyanne selalu menggagalkan serangan balik Igla ke arah Klukai di saat-saat genting.)

column1: (However, as the battle intensified, the Boojum cells on Igla's frame gradually became active and began actively repairing the areas destroyed by firearms.)
column2: (Namun, seiring pertempuran memanas, sel Boojum di frame Igla perlahan aktif dan mulai memperbaiki sendiri bagian yang hancur ditembak.)

column1: (After Igla's frame was once again attacked by Klukai and Mechty's firearms, the spreading Boojum cells accelerated their repair speed and faintly showed a trend of covering most of her frame.)
column2: (Setelah frame Igla kembali dihajar senjata Klukai dan Mechty, sel Boojum yang menyebar itu mempercepat laju perbaikannya dan samar-samar menunjukkan kecenderungan menyelimuti sebagian besar frame-nya.)

column1: (As the ranged fire support behind Klukai temporarily ceased, Igla's attacks became increasingly brutal, narrowly missing the motorcycle beneath Klukai several times.)
column2: (Saat dukungan tembakan jarak jauh di belakang Klukai sempat terhenti, serangan Igla makin brutal, beberapa kali nyaris mengenai motor yang dikendarai Klukai.)

column1: Ahhh... it automatically repaired itself again, just as expected. Why do we always run into such troublesome enemies every time?
column2: Ahhh... pulih sendiri lagi, sudah kuduga. Kenapa tiap kali kita selalu ketemu musuh serepot ini?

column1: Tch... Klukai!!!
column2: Cih... Klukai!!!

column1: (Igla's attack rhythm suddenly changed, and Boojum cells covered her body like reactive armor, blocking the firepower from Klukai and Cheyanne.)
column2: (Irama serangan Igla mendadak berubah, dan sel Boojum menyelimuti tubuhnya bagai lapis baja reaktif, menahan tembakan dari Klukai dan Cheyanne.)

column1: (Igla raised her weapon high and swung it toward Klukai's head like a god of war. However, a petite figure suddenly used her own frame to crash into Igla, knocking her back.)
column2: (Igla mengangkat senjatanya tinggi-tinggi dan mengayunkannya ke kepala Klukai bagai dewa perang. Namun, sesosok mungil tiba-tiba membanting frame-nya sendiri ke tubuh Igla, membuatnya terpental mundur.)

column1: ...Ugh... Klukai, move quickly.
column2: ...Ugh... Klukai, cepat menyingkir.

column1: (Looking at the wriggling Boojum cells on Igla's body, Mechty forcibly endured the error reports in her Neural cloud and raised her weapon.)
column2: (Menatap sel Boojum yang menggeliat di tubuh Igla, Mechty menahan paksa laporan galat di Neural cloud-nya dan mengangkat senjatanya.)

column1: Mechty, three minutes are up.
column2: Mechty, tiga menit sudah habis.

column1: (A sonic boom generated by breaking through the air sounded above everyone. Igla subconsciously raised her head and immediately caught that black figure in the sky.)
column2: (Ledakan sonik akibat menembus udara menggelegar di atas mereka semua. Igla tanpa sadar mendongak dan langsung menangkap sosok hitam di langit itu.)

column1: (Boom!)
column2: (Buum!)

column1: (A grenade accurately hit Igla who wanted to evacuate, forcing Igla to directly meet that falling figure.)
column2: (Sebuah granat tepat mengenai Igla yang hendak menyingkir, memaksanya langsung menyambut sosok yang jatuh itu.)

column1: (Accompanied by a violent impact sound, smoke and dust rose everywhere, and gravel splashed. Klukai, carrying Mechty, dodged the splashing gravel, her eyes fixed on the two figures in the smoke and dust.)
column2: (Diiringi bunyi benturan dahsyat, asap dan debu membubung di mana-mana, kerikil berhamburan. Klukai yang menggendong Mechty mengelak dari hamburan kerikil, matanya terpaku pada dua sosok di dalam asap dan debu itu.)

column1: Sorry, I'm late.
column2: Maaf, aku terlambat.

column1: Not too late, the battle is just in time.
column2: Tidak terlalu terlambat, pertempurannya justru pas.

column1: (The smoke gradually cleared, and Voymastina arrived piloting her mech. The violent impact just now had caused fine cracks on the mech's surface, but what was more serious was the injury to Igla's arm—)
column2: (Asap perlahan menipis, dan Voymastina tiba mengemudikan mech-nya. Benturan dahsyat tadi menimbulkan retakan halus di permukaan mech, tapi yang lebih parah adalah luka di lengan Igla—)

column1: (The arm, which could originally still be seen as part of the Frame, was now completely taken over by the spreading Boojum cells.)
column2: (Lengan yang semula masih tampak sebagai bagian Frame kini sepenuhnya diambil alih sel Boojum yang menjalar.)

column1: I'll hold her off.
column2: Aku yang menahannya.

column1: (While Igla's Boojum cells had not yet fully repaired the Frame, Voymastina's next wave of attacks had already descended.)
column2: (Selagi sel Boojum Igla belum sepenuhnya memulihkan Frame-nya, gelombang serangan berikutnya dari Voymastina sudah turun.)

column1: (Igla didn't care about the damage to her Frame, every move attempting to dismantle the giant mech in front of her.)
column2: (Igla tak peduli pada kerusakan Frame-nya, setiap gerakannya berusaha mencabik mech raksasa di depannya.)

column1: (Facing Igla's fierce attacks, the existence of the mech became the safest shield. Unlike Klukai who chose to dodge when facing enemy attacks, every attack from Voymastina directly hit the enemy's weak points, using the mech to forcefully withstand Igla's attacks.)
column2: (Menghadapi serangan ganas Igla, keberadaan mech itu jadi perisai teraman. Berbeda dari Klukai yang memilih mengelak saat diserang, setiap serangan Voymastina langsung menghantam titik lemah musuh, memakai mech untuk menahan paksa serangan Igla.)

column1: (The mechanized body firmly suppressed the enemy in front of it, its giant hands tearing at the constantly wriggling cells. The originally slowly spreading Boojum cells rapidly expanded and spread after being impacted, gradually evolving in a disorderly direction.)
column2: (Tubuh mesin itu menindih musuh di depannya dengan kokoh, tangan raksasanya mencabik sel-sel yang terus menggeliat. Sel Boojum yang semula menyebar lambat itu mendadak meluas dan menjalar cepat setelah dihantam, perlahan berevolusi ke arah yang kacau.)

column1: Evacuate as soon as possible. Leave this to me.
column2: Segera menyingkir. Serahkan ini padaku.

column1: Retreat? You can't do that.
column2: Mundur? Kau tidak bisa begitu.

column1: Hand over {}.
column2: Serahkan {}.

column1: {} is one of my mission objectives, and you...
column2: {} adalah salah satu sasaran misiku, dan kau...

column1: (Igla's gaze passed over Voymastina's Frame to look at the defensive stronghold behind her. She tried to shake off Voymastina, but was entangled by her and couldn't break free at all.)
column2: (Pandangan Igla melewati Frame Voymastina, menuju pos pertahanan di belakangnya. Dia berusaha melepaskan diri dari Voymastina, tapi terkunci dan sama sekali tak bisa lolos.)

column1: (Mecha and blades clashed rapidly, as Voymastina blocked Igla's path in a posture of absolute defense.)
column2: (Mech dan bilah beradu cepat, sementara Voymastina menghadang jalan Igla dalam kuda-kuda bertahan mutlak.)

column1: I'll answer that question once you've won.
column2: Pertanyaan itu akan kujawab setelah kau menang.

column1: (The battlefield was completely divided into multiple modules. The Monsoon Squad and Squad 404 successfully filled the gaps of the Oathguards, gradually defeating the surrounding enemy Doll squads.)
column2: (Medan tempur terbelah sepenuhnya menjadi beberapa bagian. Monsoon Squad dan Squad 404 berhasil menambal celah Oathguards, perlahan mengalahkan regu Doll musuh di sekitarnya.)

column1: (In the center of the battlefield, the battle centered around Voymastina cleared out a large area. The long-range support systems on both sides only applied heavy firepower bombardment to the center from afar.)
column2: (Di tengah medan tempur, pertarungan yang berpusat pada Voymastina mengosongkan area yang luas. Sistem dukungan jarak jauh kedua pihak hanya menghujani pusat itu dengan tembakan berat dari kejauhan.)

column1: (Amidst the smoke and dust, the battle between Voymastina and Igla continued. The moment she rushed out of the smoke again, the Boojum cells on Igla's body had already spread to her entire upper body.)
column2: (Di tengah asap dan debu, pertarungan Voymastina dan Igla berlanjut. Saat dia kembali menerjang keluar dari asap, sel Boojum di tubuh Igla sudah menjalar ke seluruh tubuh bagian atasnya.)
